relations.reading: Operational capture and capability analysis can define a bounded research case while preserving the context that the minimum model deliberately leaves outside.

relations.title: Coste de claridad
relations.reading: The capture-to-architecture step helps target the minimum information needed for a decision rather than treating complete documentation as the prerequisite for all action.

relations.title: Evidencia de contribución
relations.reading: The information model can preserve separate dependency and attribution channels, allowing the Attribution Gap protocol to test their divergence without building it into the data.

relations.title: Indicadores de resistencia
relations.reading: Resistance indicators can focus investigation, while capability and critical-path analysis are needed to distinguish a causal bottleneck from a visible symptom.

relations.title: Compresión narrativa de capacidad
relations.reading: The Level 1.5 transition offers a practical check on narrative compression by tracing how field observations, dependencies and responsibilities become architecture.

relations.title: Procedencia auditable
relations.reading: Operational tracking provides a way to distinguish a submitted record from evidence that has been interpreted, assigned and returned to the field as an actionable decision.

relations.title: Registro previo a admisión y promoción posterior
relations.reading: Operational tracking could retain permitted unresolved traces before lossy admission, so that later qualification can revisit evidence that actually exists.

relations.title: Núcleo común con evidencia cualificada
relations.reading: A qualified handoff could preserve the provenance and limits of operational analysis as it becomes architecture and is reused by another decision process.
